text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Hehe. I can't wait until my next<n>training session.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
You see, after I lost a race yesterday,<n>Sky was kind
enough to take me to a<n>park.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
While we were walking, I noticed all<n>the flowers at
our feet. The way they<n>swayed in the wind made it
look like<n>they were waving at us.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
They really helped me cheer up, both<n>the flowers
and Sky. So now I'm<n>feeling up to working towards
a<n>comeback!
